# Volan Premium Transfers

> Private airport transfers, minibus hire with professional drivers in Cyprus. Serving Larnaca International Airport (LCA) and Paphos International Airport (PFO) and every resort on the island, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. Bookings via WhatsApp +357 99 335570.

Key facts:
- Service: private, door-to-door transfers (never shared), private minibus tours, group transport and bus hire with driver
- Fleet: private minibuses with 8, 13, 17, 21 and 30 passengers
- Group size: any number of passengers – several vehicles are combined for large groups
- Included: meet & greet in the arrivals hall with a name sign, flight tracking (no charge for delays), free baby/child seats on request, fixed price agreed before travel, no hidden fees
- Drivers: licensed and insured, English and Greek speaking
- Coverage: Larnaca, Ayia Napa, Protaras, Paralimni, Nicosia, Limassol, Paphos, Coral Bay, Polis, Latchi, Troodos
- Hours: 24/7, including early-morning and late-night flights
- Booking: WhatsApp or phone +357 99 335570, email info@volanminibus.com, or the quote form at https://volanpremiumtransfers.com/#quote. No payment is required to book.

Typical journey times (approximate, traffic dependent):
- Larnaca Airport → Ayia Napa: ~48 km, 40–45 min
- Larnaca Airport → Protaras: ~58 km, 45–55 min
- Larnaca Airport → Nicosia: ~50 km, 40–45 min
- Larnaca Airport → Limassol: ~70 km, 50–60 min
- Larnaca Airport → Paphos: ~140 km, 1 h 40 – 1 h 50
- Paphos Airport → Paphos town: ~15 km, 20 min
- Paphos Airport → Coral Bay: ~25 km, 25–30 min
- Paphos Airport → Limassol: ~60 km, 45–55 min
